objective: Frozen computation: every arrangement of the four not-all-equal-class knots with periods (1,1), (2,1), (1,2), and 150 random each with (3,1), (1,3), (2,2): flip-split transfer spectra (spin and energy gaps) at widths 6 to 12, classification, direct correlations for disordered ones, and the gauge check.
status: Closed 2026-11-17 (inconclusive; referee pending): 2 of 6 frozen predictions held (Q2: >2 inconsistent per cell empty, 29/29; Q4 as frozen). Q0, Q1, Q3, Q5 failed from one cause: arrangements with the same inconsistent bonds differ by the twist around the cylinder, and the frozen rule compared widths of opposite parity, so gauge copies of the critical law read 'disordered'. Post hoc (labelled, same-parity widths): 4 odd-count arrangements look disordered (two 3 x 1 gauge copies: gaps 0.32/0.63 per row stable at widths 6-12, correlations decaying), none with all counts even; the referee's 2 x 2 law unresolved.
title: Which mixed arrangements on the weave are disordered
